source: Pew Research Center. 2009. "Faith in Flux: Changes in Religious Affiliation in the U.S."
method: Population is all respondents who left the religion they were raised in (this recontact survey's own design - all 2,867 respondents had changed religious tradition or moved within one since childhood). Each reason's own don't know/refused excluded from its own denominator. Weighted by the dataset's own `weight` variable.
reason_order: Found a religion they liked more
Stopped believing in the religion's teachings
Married someone of a different religion
Wasn't comfortable with the community there
